name: veda.ng Research Hub MCP Server
description: MCP server over Streamable HTTP exposing essays, glossary definitions, and 233,000+ indexed academic papers as tools for AI agents.

tools.name: search_essays
tools.description: Search long-form essays on AI agents, AI policy, and Web3 by title and summary.

tools.name: get_essay
tools.description: Full Markdown text of one essay by URL slug.

tools.name: search_glossary
tools.description: Search the AI & Web3 glossary (100+ terms); returns previews.

tools.name: get_glossary_term
tools.description: Full Markdown definition of one glossary term by slug.

tools.name: search_reports
tools.description: Search 233,000+ academic papers via OpenAlex in the AI or Web3 corpus.

tools.name: scan_agent_readiness
tools.description: Audit any public domain's AI and agentic web readiness. Returns a 0-100 score, grade, and per-check findings across Discovery, Access, Usability, Security, SEO, and Micropayments layers.

input.url: string (required — domain or full URL, e.g. 'stripe.com' or 'https://github.com')
